reproducible_count_check_python:
import ast, json, re
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
p = Path("docs/evidence/execution-gate-coverage-20260906.json")
a = json.loads(p.read_text())
rows = a["inventory"]
assert len(rows) == 35
prefix = complete = literal_choices = flat_defects = 0
for r in rows:
    item = r["exact_source_record"]
    stem = item["prompt"]
    try:
        values = [ast.literal_eval(c) for c in item["choices"]]
        literal_choices += 1
    except (SyntaxError, ValueError):
        values = None
    leading = stem.startswith("def ") and "\n\n" in stem
    prefix += int(leading)
    if leading:
        source, tail = stem.split("\n\n", 1)
        m = re.fullmatch(r"What does (.+) return\?", tail)
        if m:
            call = ast.parse(m.group(1), mode="eval").body
            assert isinstance(call, ast.Call) and isinstance(call.func, ast.Name)
            for arg in call.args:
                ast.literal_eval(arg)
            for keyword in call.keywords:
                assert keyword.arg is not None
                ast.literal_eval(keyword.value)
            assert values is not None
            complete += 1
    if r["classification"] == "invalid_flattened_definition_mixed_with_prose":
        flat_defects += 1
        assert not leading
assert (prefix, complete, literal_choices, flat_defects) == (7, 2, 34, 5)
assert Counter(r["archive_family"] for r in rows) == {"schema": 20, "layout": 10, "full_pipeline": 5}
